description: 8-bit streaming accumulator datapath with skid buffer and accumulator core.
interface_contract: top.in_valid -> skid_buffer.in_valid; top.in_data -> skid_buffer.in_data; skid_buffer.out_valid -> accumulator_core.sample_valid; skid_buffer.out_data -> accumulator_core.sample; accumulator_core.sample_ready -> skid_buffer.out_ready; accumulator_core.sum -> top.sum
